title: Account Manager - Microsoft Ads - Cairo - Egypt
description:
InMobi (Corporate)
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.
InMobi Advertising
InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
Glance
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
What will you be doing?
Microsoft Advertising and InMobi have entered a partnership. As per which, InMobi will be the exclusive partner for Microsoft’s Advertising solutions in various regions. Microsoft Advertising empowers the largest advertisers around the world to reach their maximum potential through paid search, display, native & CTV on the Microsoft Ads platform. InMobi will be responsible for complete management / transaction across Microsoft Ads.
We are seeking an Arabic speaking Account Manager with search advertising experience, attention to detail, customer obsession and passion to learn and adapt in an evolving environment. The individual will be coordinating with a team of Account Strategists and supporting Account Management Head to achieve customer satisfaction and revenue objectives. As an AM, you will be serving corporate customers and/or agencies, by applying customer obsession to what clients care about and need, and building and maintaining strong, trusted-advisor relationships with day-to-day practitioner contacts at advertiser/agency/tool provider. The AM will be responsible to manage an assigned set of clients focused on attaining revenue targets, feature adoption and client driven goals
Role requirement & expectation:
- Shared culture of diversity and respect: Create a collaborative, trust-based work environment where differences in communication styles are considered, and the perspectives of others are respected and valued. Always Demonstrate Microsoft Advertising’s culture of inclusiveness and diversity. Contribute to the success of others by promoting mutual learning
- Strong customer relationships and account health: Own the day-to-day management for newly onboarded & existing customers. Flawless execution of campaigns. Strong coordination with internal resources for execution of core tasks. Awareness and understanding of all required billing and compliance requirements. Contribute to quality and actionable Customer Plan.
- Pursue optimizations to deliver quota expectations: Drive campaign-level budget upsell and optimization opportunities that align to ROI goals of client and drive incremental revenue. Leverage internal tool-directed tactics to inform and prioritize upsells and optimizations, seeking to drive swift implementation. Drive tactic improvement by providing thoughtful feedback to make opportunities more relevant to client goals. Leverage self-serve tools and community forums to deliver insights for non-Insights enabled clients.
- Fluent advocate of the Microsoft Advertising Story: Educate clients on how the MS Ads platform and existing features help them to reach their business goals and execute on budgets. Ensure regular client engagement with the Microsoft Ads platform and aim to reduce customer reliance on AM for routine tasks. Utilize all available readiness and insights to ensure you are a fluent advocate of the Microsoft Advertising story. Develop and demonstrate an intermediate level knowledge of emerging products/features.
- Collaborative and high-performing account team:  Ensure timely and proactive customer escalations by effectively leveraging Account Executive and internal partner network to resolve day-to-day escalations & revenue blockers. Partner with account team to submit actionable feedback on product, tool and processes through relevant channels. Own and effectively execute the customer transition process and operational excellence in execution of change management (Book of Business update).
- Continuous business learning and professional growth: Continuously, strengthen your Microsoft Advertising and Search Industry expertise, take personal accountability for your career and personal development; create, update and regularly check in on your career development plan. Complete required and recommended trainings and apply what you learn to further your growth in role and career progression.
What is expected out of you?
- Minimum 5 years Search Engine Marketing or Online Media and Service experience required
- Strong knowledge of Digital advertising: CPA, CPM, CPC, search marketing, lead generation, direct response, etc.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving tools with a 'can do' attitude and the ability to partner collaboratively with other functional areas within the company in support of the sales process.
- Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals or targets
- Proven ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions
- Effectively navigate through ambiguity and complexities related to client management
- Talented in storytelling and delivering engaging presentations
- Solid knowledge of the search industry, trends, and customers needs
- Passion for technology as an enabler for customer and company growth
- Bachelor’s degree required. MBA preferable
- Critical thinker who is organized and can make decision based on clear priorities
- Collaborative teammate who can build successful team relationships with partners; and can prioritize multiple tasks
- Flexible and able to quickly adapt to changing business needs and processes
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Willingness to travel
- Arabic and English proficiency
Preferred
- Microsoft Ads Certification
- Experienced using Excel to analyse information, including data manipulation, V-Lookups, creating and using pivot tables, and data analysis
The InMobi Culture
At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

title: Applied Scientist III
description:
InMobi (Corporate)
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
Glance
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
Overview of the role:
We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You'll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale, while owning problems end to end. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. We leverage the latest deep learning models alongside classical machine learning techniques to build innovative solutions.
As the heart of the InMobi Exchange, our team optimizes the company's core business functions and creates the strategic moat that sets us apart in the market. As an Applied Scientist, you will not just "use models"—you will formulate them, evaluate their assumptions, tailor them to our problem domain, and bring them to life in production. Many of our challenges have no off-the-shelf solutions; we require scientific creativity to bridge research and reality.
If you thrive on solving complex, high-impact problems and want to see your ideas shape the future of a global exchange, this is the place where your work will truly make a difference.
The impact you'll make:
- Formulate, analyze, and implement algorithms that power real-time auctions, dynamic pricing, bid shaping, pacing, and traffic allocation across a massive-scale ad marketplace.
- Design and experiment with methods in online learning, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, forecasting, game theory, and Bayesian modeling—in non-stationary, adversarial environments.
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy your models in production and run real-world experiments with rapid feedback loops (measured in hours, not weeks).
- Participate in scientific design reviews and contribute to raising the methodological bar of the team.
- Contribute to the scientific community by publishing high-quality research, conducting internal seminars, and staying abreast of advances in machine learning, algorithms, and applied statistics.
- Evaluate the long-term dynamics of deployed algorithms, incorporating feedback, exploitation-exploration trade-offs, and incentives within multi-agent systems.
- Help identify new areas for innovation by translating business challenges into research questions and proposing novel, high-impact methodologies.
- Translate mathematical ideas into practical, high-performance algorithms that operate at scale in production environments.
- Explore and close the loop between model predictions and real-world outcomes, refining algorithms based on system behavior.
The experience we need:
- A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline is strongly preferred. A degree is not a hard requirement—demonstrated research depth and production impact count.
- 4–7 years of experience working on algorithmic or applied research problems, including significant production deployment experience. Candidates with more or less experience are welcome to apply—we hire across Applied Scientist II, Applied Scientist III, and Staff Applied Scientist levels.
- Deep grounding in one or more of:
- Statistical learning theory, mathematical optimization, discrete algorithms, probability theory, and information theory
- Causal inference, decision theory, game theory, auction theory
- Online learning, bandits, RL, Bayesian methods
- Strong publication record (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, AISTATS, KDD, UAI, WSDM, EC, SODA, COLT) is a strong plus—even if not recent.
- Proficient in scientific computing with Python, including packages such as NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
- Comfortable working with big data platforms like Apache Spark, distributed computing, and large-scale datasets.
- A researcher's mindset: questions first, implementation later. You are thoughtful about assumptions and rigorous about validation.
- End-to-end ownership: you can go from idea to production and thrive in applied settings.
Prior experience in ad tech, marketplaces, or dynamic pricing is helpful but not required.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

The Opportunity
A set of scaled consumer platforms have built meaningful advertising businesses on their own properties in recent years. The natural next step is extending that reach beyond their own environments — in a way that keeps the platform in control of its data, its customer relationships, and its economics.
InMobi's Audience Network is built to make that step straightforward. We're hiring a senior commercial leader in the US to open these doors and close these partnerships.
Overview of the Role
This is a senior individual contributor and business development role with a clear mandate: identify, engage, and close Audience Network partnerships with large US consumer platforms across commerce, travel, mobility and payments.
You will be selling to CXOs — CEOs, CROs, Chief Digital Officers, and the GMs who own advertising P&Ls — at companies whose primary business is not advertising. This leader will serve as the single-threaded owner of the DSP commerce story, grounded in a strong outside-in, voice-of-the-customer perspective. The role defines what we build, for whom, why it matters, and how it should be understood in the market — operating upstream of traditional sales enablement and ensuring that product and go-to-market decisions are anchored in real customer behavior and market dynamics.
In addition to commerce use cases, this role will own product marketing for app user acquisition, re-engagement, and retargeting, positioning these capabilities as foundational inputs to commerce and lifecycle outcomes — not standalone performance features. This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping how our DSP is understood by customers, partners, and the broader industry.
This role is based in either our San Mateo, CA, or New York, NY, office and requires regular in-office presence. Occasional travel may be required for client meetings, industry events, and strategic partner engagement.
The Impact You’ll Make:
Outside-In Market & Customer Insight (Foundational)
- Act as the voice of the customer for DSP-led commerce and app growth products
- Build a deep understanding of:
- Buyer motivations, constraints, and decision criteria
- How commerce, performance, and retail media network (RMN) budgets are actually allocated
- What customers say they want versus what they actually buy
- Use customer insight to:
- Define ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and buying personas
- Prioritize the highest-impact use cases
- Pressure-test internal assumptions
- Serve as the internal arbiter of market reality when perspectives diverge
Commerce Strategy & Narrative (Primary Ownership)
- Define what “Commerce in the DSP” means — including outcomes, ICPs, use cases, and clear differentiation versus retail media networks, retail media platforms, and performance DSPs.
- Build and own the end-to-end commerce narrative, including:
- Problem framing rooted in customer pain points
- A clear value proposition tied to measurable business outcomes
- A compelling articulation of why DSP-native commerce versus alternative solutions
- Ensure positioning reflects how customers actually talk, evaluate, and buy, rather than internal product architecture.
App User Acquisition, Re-engagement & Retargeting (Core Use-Case Pillar)
- Own the product marketing strategy and narrative for: App user acquisition, User re-engagement, and Retargeting and lifecycle marketing
- Position these capabilities as inputs into commerce and lifecycle outcomes — such as conversion, repeat purchase, and lifetime value (LTV) — rather than isolated performance tactics.
- Define ICPs, buying triggers, and success metrics for growth and performance marketers.
- Ensure consistent storytelling across full-funnel and lifecycle marketing motions, reinforcing a unified customer journey narrative.
Ecosystem Depth
- Lead product marketing strategy across the broader ecosystem, supporting DSP-led commerce and growth.
- Run product marketing initiatives for third-party DSP integrations and strategic platform partnerships.
- Own product marketing engagement with marquee measurement and attribution partners, ensuring alignment between product capabilities, performance insights, and customer value.
Product GTM & Launch Strategy
- Own PR/FAQ frameworks, positioning documentation, launch narratives, and go-to-market strategies for commerce and app growth products.
- Demonstrate the ability to execute both product-led growth (PLG) and sales-led growth (SLG) motions.
- Partner closely with Product to drive a working-backwards approach, including: Validating ICP and buyer needs before build; defining success metrics that customers genuinely care about; and influencing roadmap prioritization using market insight
- Drive event-led and moment-led launches with clear strategic intent, ensuring launches are timely, differentiated, and outcome-driven.
Cross-Functional & Team Leadership
- Act as the product marketing leader for the DSP commerce and app growth domain, working closely across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Business leadership.
- Build and mentor product marketers focused on outcome-driven, market-first product marketing practices.
- Serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership on:
- Where commerce and app growth should be positioned within the DSP strategy
- Where investments should be prioritized
- Where capabilities do, and do not, create meaningful customer value
The Experience We Need:
- Proven experience in product marketing, platform marketing, or go-to-market strategy within the Adtech, Martech, commerce media, or retail media ecosystem
- Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear, differentiated market positioning that drives adoption and revenue growth
- Strong understanding of commerce, performance marketing, and retail media network dynamics, including how budgets are allocated and how buying decisions are made
- Experience defining category narratives, value propositions, and product positioning in competitive and rapidly evolving markets
- Ability to operate with an outside-in, customer-first mindset, using market insight to shape product and go-to-market strategy
- Track record of partnering closely with Product teams to influence roadmap decisions and drive successful product launches
- Experience executing both PLG and SLG go-to-market motions in high-growth technology environments
- Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior executives
- Experience building and mentoring product marketing talent and establishing scalable product marketing practices
- Comfort operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where priorities evolve, and strategic judgment is essential
What we build…
At InMobi, we’re building products that are redefining industries. Our ecosystem spans:
- InMobi Advertising – Powering data-driven mobile marketing for the world’s leading brands
- Glance – A revolutionary Gen AI-powered lockscreen & TV content platform transforming how millions discover and engage with content.
- 1Weather – One of the world’s leading weather platforms, delivering precise, reliable, and real-time weather forecasts
With deep expertise in AI, mobile, consumer technology, and digital innovation, we are home to some of the brightest minds in the industry.
What sets us apart? Not just what we build. How we build it. At InMobi, we balance our hunger for cutting-edge tech with a deep focus on our people - their growth, well-being, and potential.
At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…
- Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
- Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
- Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
- Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
- Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks
Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits
Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.
The base salary (fixed) for this role ranges from $206,500 – $275,000 USD (min to max of base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

description:

Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
About the Role
Glance operates one of the world’s largest owned-and-operated mobile surfaces, reaching hundreds of millions of users across US, India, LATAM, Japan and Southeast Asia.
As Director – Programmatic Monetization, you will own the programmatic business end-to-end — from revenue and yield to demand partnerships, auction strategy, new monetization capabilities and the team that drives them.
This is a global leadership role with direct accountability for building the next phase of Glance’s programmatic monetization engine.
What will you be doing?
- Revenue & Growth: Own global programmatic revenue, growth strategy, annual plans and forecasts across markets.
- Global Demand Partnerships: Build and manage senior relationships with SSPs, exchanges and agencies, including commercial terms, strategic partnerships and supply commitments.
- Deals & Auction Packages: Drive growth of PMP, PG and curated auction packages, increasing their contribution to overall programmatic revenue.
- Programmatic Capabilities: Define and build new auction, bidding, yield and monetization capabilities that expand what Glance can monetize.
- Format Innovation: Identify, develop and scale new ad formats and placements across Glance’s surfaces while balancing monetization with user experience.
- AI-First Monetization: Establish AI as a core operating layer for the monetization function — using AI to forecast, detect anomalies, optimize yield, automate reporting and improve decision-making, while applying judgment on where AI adds real value.
- Policy & Platform Readiness: Ensure compliance with platform, privacy and industry policies, while driving Glance’s approval, onboarding and readiness across major demand platforms.
- Industry Representation: Represent Glance with global demand partners, industry forums and relevant advertising bodies, shaping conversations around programmatic, publisher monetization and emerging standards.
- Team & Organization: Build, structure and scale the programmatic monetization organization, establishing clear ownership, operating rhythms and strong functional depth.
What is expected out of you?
- 12+ years of experience in ad tech, with senior ownership of programmatic or publisher-side revenue at a large publisher, SSP, exchange, app developer or similar ecosystem.
- A proven track record of owning revenue metrics with experience building plans, forecasts and growth strategies.
- Deep hands-on understanding of the programmatic stack, including auction mechanics, bidding architecture, ad serving, measurement, identity and yield optimization. You should be able to go deep enough with engineering and partners to challenge assumptions and identify the real constraint.
- Strong publisher-side monetization expertise, including pricing, yield management, demand optimization and the trade-offs between revenue, fill, latency and user experience.
- Leverage AI to drive efficiency and performance — use AI models and tooling to forecast performance, identify anomalies, optimize yield, automate workflows and reduce manual reporting, while applying human judgment where it adds the most value.
- Experience operating across multiple global markets, with a strong understanding of how programmatic strategy, demand dynamics, pricing and user behavior differ by geography. US market experience is a strong plus.
- A demonstrated ability to build, lead and level up high-performing teams, with experience hiring strong talent, developing leaders and creating scalable operating structures.
- Strong commercial and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across product, engineering, sales, finance, legal and external partners.
- A strategic thinker who can move seamlessly between long-term business strategy and the technical details of an auction happening today.

- Drive compliance across all global offices in alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational policies.

Audit & Certification Management

- Ensure adherence to SLAs, contractual obligations, and compliance requirements.
- Conduct vendor audits, due diligence, and risk assessments to maintain governance standards.
Risk Management & Incident Handling
- Identify compliance risks across operations and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
- Lead investigation and resolution of compliance breaches, ensuring corrective and preventive actions.
- Maintain strong incident reporting mechanisms and governance tracking.
Data Privacy & Systems Compliance
- Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) within workplace systems.
- Work closely with InfoSec teams on CCTV data handling, access control policies, and system security compliance.
Policy, Process & Standardization
- Develop and implement standardized global policies for workspace operations, compliance, and safety.
- Continuously improve processes to drive efficiency, scalability, and audit readiness.
Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
- Partner with Legal, Finance, HR, InfoSec, and Procurement teams to ensure seamless compliance execution.
- Provide regular compliance dashboards, insights, and updates to leadership.
- Act as a trusted advisor on compliance risks and governance decisions.
Training & Culture Building
- Drive compliance awareness and training programs across global offices.
- Build a strong culture of accountability, safety, and ethical practices within workplace operations.

- 10+ years of experience in global compliance, facilities, or governance roles
- Strong expertise in ISO standards, audits, GDPR, and workplace compliance frameworks
- Proven experience in managing multi-country operations and vendor ecosystems
- Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills
- Analytical mindset with strong risk assessment and problem-solving capabilities
Success Metrics
- Successful completion of ISO and compliance audits with minimal observations

You could be designing a campaign one day, shooting an employee story the next, editing a reel, creating a handbook or experimenting with AI to find a better way to bring an idea to life.

Through Glance AI, we are shaping AI Commerce, reimagining the future of e-commerce with inspiration-led discovery and shopping. Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, and by MIT Technology Review, Fast Company’s Top 10 Innovators, and more, InMobi is a workplace where bold ideas create global impact. Backed by investors including SoftBank, Kleiner Perkins, and Sherpalo Ventures, InMobi has offices across San Mateo, New York, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Jakarta, Bengaluru and beyond.

What will you be doing?
Microsoft and InMobi have entered into partnership. As per which, InMobi will be exclusive partner for Microsoft’s Advertising inventory. Microsoft Advertising empowers the largest advertisers around the world to reach their maximum potential through paid search engine marketing on the Microsoft Ads platform. InMobi will be responsible for complete management / transaction across Bing.
We are seeking a Lead Account Manager with search advertising experience an attention to detail, customer obsession and passion to learn and adapt in an evolving environment. The individual will be coordinating with a team of Account Strategists and supporting Account Management Head to achieve customer satisfaction and revenue objectives. As an AM, you will be serving Corporate customers by applying customer obsession to what clients care about and need, and building and maintaining strong, trusted-advisor relationships with day-to-day practitioner contacts at advertiser/agency/tool provider. The AM will be responsible to manage an assigned set of clients focused on attaining revenue targets, feature adoption and client driven goals
Role requirement & expectation:
- Shared culture of diversity and respect: Create a collaborative, trust-based work environment where differences in communication styles are considered, and the perspectives of others are respected and valued. Demonstrate Search Advertising’s culture of inclusiveness and diversity at all times. Contribute to the success of others by promoting mutual learning
- Strong customer relationships and account health: Own the day-to-day management for newly onboarded & existing customers. Flawless execution of campaigns. Strong coordination with internal resources for execution of core tasks. Awareness and understanding of all required billing and compliance requirements. Contribute to quality and actionable Customer Plan.
- Pursue optimizations to deliver quota expectations: Drive campaign-level budget upsell and optimization opportunities that align to ROI goals of client and drive incremental revenue. Leverage internal tool-directed tactics to inform and prioritize upsells and optimizations, seeking to drive swift implementation. Drive tactic improvement by providing thoughtful feedback to make opportunities more relevant to client goals. Leverage self-serve tools and community forums to deliver insights for non-Insights enabled clients.
- Fluent advocate of the Bing Story: Educate clients on how the Bing Ads platform and existing features help them to reach their business goals and execute on budgets. Ensure regular client engagement with the BingAds platform, and aim to reduce customer reliance on AM for routine tasks. Utilize all available readiness and insights to ensure you are a fluent advocate of the Bing story. Develop and demonstrate an intermediate level knowledge of emerging products/features.
- Collaborative and high-performing account team:  Ensure timely and proactive customer escalations by effectively leveraging Account Executive and internal partner network to resolve day-to-day escalations & revenue blockers. Partner with account team to submit actionable feedback on product, tool and processes through relevant channels. The team combines exceptional client servicing skills with an excellent understanding of the technological, operational, and commercial aspects of the mobile advertising ecosystem. What will you be doing?

This role is a client facing one where the person will be the primary POC for driving any kind of client conversation associated with his/her set of key accounts. This person will own stakeholder management both internally (Sales, Product, Adops, Engg, Design, Supply, Legal, Finance, Marketing) and externally (Advertisers and Agencies) to drive cross-functional support to maximize media flow and net revenue, as well as strengthen the customer relationship with InMobi. We are looking for sharp, analytical, quick learners with strong communication skills, client facing experience and a positive attitude, who can solve complex problems in a structured manner, have experience of working in cross-functional roles and develop close strategic relationships with key clients in the mobile programmatic ecosystem, while proactively and clearly communicating data and insights to sales, supply, product teams and to global leadership.
Key Responsibilities:
- Complete ownership of account management and media flow/revenue targets from a portfolio of key clients in India focusing on performance marketing on Inmobi DSP
- Develop strong client relationships with advertisers and agencies – managing their expectation and resolving their day-to-day queries
- Build a strong hold on the different lines of business from technical, operational and commercial aspect to have a clear understanding of the optimizations required to scale the accounts
- Grow accounts by cross-selling and up-selling new market opportunities, products, etc. by utilizing data-driven insights and forecasting to support recommendations
- Build strong internal stakeholder relationship and orchestrate the cross-functional support required to ensure that ad campaigns are delivered to meet client expectations: Track and resolve key client issues in a proactive manner and manage expectations internally and externally
- Ability to take ownership and getting things done in the stipulated time
- Provide feedback and help shape the product, data and supply roadmaps by communicating client requirements and larger market trends
- Lead key strategic conversations and drivers required to increase the overall revenue of India region
- This role is based out of Bangalore
What do we require from you?
Must have:
- Work experience of 7+ years
- Bachelor’s degree (MBA will be a plus)

Title: Manager - Executive Assistant

We are looking for a highly experienced and proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative and strategic support to senior leadership. This is a high-visibility role that demands exceptional discretion, sharp organizational instincts, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment.

- Proactively anticipate and resolve scheduling conflicts
- Coordinate internal/external meetings, calls, and events across time zones and departments

- Act as primary point of contact — screening and triaging high-volume email and requests
- Liaise confidently with internal stakeholders, external partners, clients, and senior executives

- Maintain organized filing systems for sensitive records and correspondence
- Coordinate with vendors and service providers, tracking key deliverables and timelines
- Manage contracts, invoices, and expense workflows through approval and signature processes

- Arrange comprehensive domestic and international travel — flights, hotels, visas, and itineraries

- Track action items and deliverables from leadership meetings

- Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive, confidential information with discretion

Role overview
We are looking for a Lead – Workspace Transportation to manage employee transportation for our Bangalore office. As the service expands, this role will own daily operations, vendor performance, route planning, employee communication, and cost control, with a strong focus on safety and reliable pickup and drop services.
The lead will be the primary contact for transportation matters and work closely with Workspace leadership, transport partners, Security, HR, Finance, and Procurement. The role requires hands-on operational ownership, sound judgment during disruptions, and a practical understanding of Bangalore traffic and employee commuting needs.
Key responsibilities
Daily operations and capacity planning
- Oversee daily pickup and drop operations, including trip scheduling, vehicle allocation, driver readiness, dispatch, and completion tracking.
- Plan service capacity using employee demand, office attendance, shift timings, new joiner requirements, and approved service coverage.
- Coordinate route planning and pickup points to balance employee convenience, travel time, vehicle occupancy, and cost. Review routes regularly as demand changes.
- Account for Bangalore traffic, rain, road closures, and peak-hour congestion when setting schedules. Arrange approved backup vehicles and vendors for disruptions.
- Monitor live trips through the transport platform and vendor control teams. Respond promptly to delays, missed pickups, vehicle breakdowns, and last-minute changes.
- Maintain clear operating procedures for bookings, cancellations, no-shows, route changes, exceptions, and escalation handovers.
Vendor and driver management
- Manage transport partners against agreed service levels, fleet commitments, pricing, and response times. Conduct regular reviews and document corrective actions.
- Coordinate with vendor supervisors and dispatch teams to ensure sufficient vehicles, qualified drivers, and operational support for each service window.
- Assess proposed vendors with Procurement and relevant teams, compare quotations, and support commercial discussions and onboarding.
- Monitor driver conduct, punctuality, route adherence, and complaints. Require vendors to address inappropriate behaviour and recurring performance issues.
- Track vendor contracts, renewal dates, rate cards, and service commitments. Maintain an updated contact directory and escalation matrix.
Safety service quality and financial ownership
Employee safety and transport compliance
- Coordinate verification of driver identity, licences, background checks, and required vehicle documents through approved company and vendor processes.
- Track validity of applicable vehicle permits, insurance, fitness, pollution certificates, and other required records with vendors and the relevant internal teams.
- Ensure vendors follow company-approved transport safety procedures, including applicable requirements for late-hour travel and women employee safety.
- Monitor the availability and functioning of required vehicle safety features, tracking systems, emergency contacts, and communication arrangements.
- Coordinate periodic vehicle and service checks with vendors. Escalate unsafe vehicles or drivers promptly and arrange replacements before service resumes.
- Handle employee location, contact, and trip data confidentially, with access and sharing limited to approved business needs.
Escalations and emergency response
- Act as the primary operational escalation contact for employee transport concerns and coordinate timely resolution with vendors and internal teams.
- Maintain response procedures for accidents, breakdowns, safety concerns, severe weather, and service disruptions. Coordinate with Security and emergency services when needed.
- Keep employees informed of delays and alternative arrangements through approved channels, with clear updates until the issue is resolved.
- Prepare contingency plans for vehicle shortages, vendor outages, and driver availability issues, including approved alternate providers.
- Document incidents, investigate causes with the responsible teams, and track preventive actions. Escalate material safety or service failures to Workspace leadership.
- Provide support during critical service windows and after-hours emergencies under an agreed coverage arrangement, with documented backup and handovers.
Budgets billing and cost control
- Prepare transportation budgets and demand forecasts. Monitor monthly spending and highlight variances or additional funding needs before commitments are made.
- Validate vendor invoices against completed trips, approved rate cards, kilometres or hours where applicable, and authorised additional charges.
- Maintain supporting trip records, approvals, purchase orders where applicable, invoices, and reconciliation reports for payment and audit.
- Work with Finance and Procurement to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure approved payments are processed within agreed timelines.
- Improve vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, reduce avoidable empty runs and no-shows, and assess savings without compromising safety or agreed service standards.
Employee experience reporting and candidate requirements
Employee communication and continuous improvement
- Explain transport eligibility, booking processes, pickup schedules, cancellations, and service changes clearly to employees.
- Coordinate with HR and Workspace teams to support new joiner transport onboarding and changes in employee commuting requirements.
- Collect employee feedback, track complaints to closure, and identify recurring issues requiring route changes or vendor action.
- Maintain an operational dashboard covering punctuality, completed and missed trips, occupancy, complaints, incidents, vendor performance, and costs.
- Share regular updates with Workspace leadership and recommend service improvements supported by operational data. Establish measurable service targets with leadership and vendors.
Education and experience
- Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A qualification in operations, logistics, supply chain, hospitality, or business administration is preferred.
- Preferably five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate employee transportation, fleet operations, or transport vendor management, including experience independently leading operations.
- Experience managing multiple transport vendors, service escalations, route planning, billing validation, and operational reporting.
- Strong understanding of Bangalore commuting patterns and practical experience managing services during traffic congestion and operational disruptions.
- Experience using employee transport management platforms such as RouteMatic or similar systems is preferred.
Skills and working approach
- Strong English communication and stakeholder coordination. Working knowledge of Kannada or Hindi is helpful for local vendor coordination.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including expense trackers, data reconciliation, and service dashboards; working knowledge of Word and PowerPoint.
- Ability to prioritise live operational issues, make decisions within delegated authority, and escalate risks early.
- Strong negotiation, attention to detail, and follow-through, with a service mindset and a firm approach to safety and vendor accountability.
- Ability to guide vendor supervisors and transport coordinators, maintain clear handovers, and support onsite operations across required service windows.
Measures of success
- Pickup and drop punctuality and trip fulfilment against agreed service targets.
- Timely resolution of employee concerns and fewer recurring vendor failures.
- Complete and current driver and vehicle verification records, with safety actions tracked to closure.
- Accurate billing reconciliation, timely monthly reporting, and spending within approved budgets.
- Improved vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, supported by a tested contingency and escalation plan.

- Lead the Application Security program across products, platforms, and engineering teams, defining strategy, roadmap, and measurable KPIs for AppSec and AI security maturity.

Process re-engineering

The Global Enterprise Marketing team operates across brands, channels, events, and geographies, and moves fast. We're looking for a sharp, organized Marketing Events & Operations Coordinator to be the connective tissue that keeps it all running during our highest-stakes, most visible moments.
This role reports to the Head of Experiential Marketing and supports the broader cross-functional enterprise marketing team across InMobi and Glance, our two distinct businesses. You'll be the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks on our highest-stakes initiatives: milestones are hit, partners are orchestrated, and events get executed with excellence, all while keenly tracking budgets and business results.
The highest priority focus for this role is supporting InMobi Group events in the USA and abroad, including end-to-end coordination across a range of industry events as well as more curated custom activations and experiences, both in-person and virtual. A secondary area of responsibility includes broader marketing operations support, including project coordination, vendor management, budgeting and expense administration, and navigating internal Legal, Finance, and Procurement processes.
This early career role is for someone with 1–3 years of professional experience that has prepared them to thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly changing organization during an accelerated phase of growth. The right candidate takes initiative, is highly organized, resourceful, and naturally curious about the finer details that go into making modern marketing events and organizations successful. They find fulfillment bringing structure to complex projects and coordinating across multiple stakeholders, time zones, and environments without losing momentum.
Location: This role is based on-site in our New York, New York office, with travel up to 50% of the time, both domestic and international.
The Impact You'll Make:
Event Operations
- Support the planning and execution of a range of marketing events, including industry conferences and trade shows, partner events, and custom curated experiences designed to delight our most discerning prospects, customers, partners, and internal leadership
- Build and track cross-functional event plans and milestones, ensuring critical timelines are met while constantly seeking opportunities to standardize and improve processes
- Coordinate end-to-end event logistics including contract deliverables, lead capture, venue management, hospitality, branding, giveaways, exhibits, product demos, shipping, group housing, meeting schedules, on-site staffing, equipment, and support services
- Partner with marketing, business, and third-party stakeholders to coordinate pre-event, onsite, and post-event planning, promotion, and measurement
- Schedule and coordinate internal and partner meetings, including agenda prep, note-taking, and follow-up on action items
- Coordinate with creative, content, communications, sales, product, and other internal teams to ensure event assets and messaging are produced accurately and on time
- Provide onsite event support when required, including vendor coordination, setup, registration, troubleshooting, and other executional needs
- Support post-event wrap-up, including vendor closeout, invoice reconciliation, internal debriefs, ROI, and documentation of learnings and next steps
Vendor Management & Finance Operations
- Own the end-to-end vendor onboarding process, collecting required documentation, submitting onboarding requests, and ensuring new vendors are set up in company systems before work begins
- Manage the full contract lifecycle for marketing vendors and partners: initiating requests, routing for review and approvals, tracking signatures, and maintaining a central contracts log
- Process invoices and expense reports accurately and on time, ensuring vendors are paid according to agreed terms
- Liaise with Finance and Legal to resolve onboarding or payment issues and keep projects moving
- Maintain organized records of all vendor agreements, POs, and payment history
General Marketing Operations
- Provide project coordination and operational support for cross-functional marketing initiatives in close collaboration with peers and marketing management
- Maintain standard marketing calendars, repositories, project trackers, documentation, templates, and shared resources
- Identify recurring administrative friction and suggest ways to simplify, automate, and standardize processes
- Coordinate inputs and deliverables across marketing teams and other internal stakeholders
- Support marketing budget administration and help maintain accurate records of planned, committed, and actual spend
- Assist with agency and vendor administration across the broader marketing organization
- Support onboarding of new marketing vendors, tools, or services from an operational perspective
- Provide ad hoc operational and project support to the marketing organization as priorities evolve
The Experience We Need:
- 1–3 years of experience in events, marketing operations, or related roles within a fast-paced environment
- Demonstrated experience managing vendor relationships, contracts, and invoicing processes
- Strong project management skills; you track the details, own the follow-up, and don't need to be reminded twice
- Comfortable working across time zones and coordinating with global teams
- Highly organized and accountable with a low tolerance for things falling through the cracks
- Clear, professional spoken and written communication; you can lead a call, demonstrate a product, draft a vendor email, or fire off a sharp WhatsApp update with equal ease
- Proficiency with project management tools (Asana, Workfront, Monday, or similar) and event management tools (Splash, Cvent, Luma, Eventbrite, or similar), as well as Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
- Desire and ability to travel up to 50% of the time, both domestic and international
Preferred:
- Experience supporting a marketing or events team at a B2B tech or AdTech company
- Familiarity with procurement, legal routing, or finance systems (Coupa, SAP Concur, DocuSign, Ramp, Oracle Fusion, or similar)
- Experience supporting large-scale events or trade show activations
- Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to prioritize across multiple competing demands
At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…
- Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
- Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
- Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
- Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
- Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks
Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits
Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.
The base salary (fixed) for this role ranges from $77,900 to $89,250 USD (min to max of base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*.
Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.

To learn more, visit glance.com.
Who are we and What do we do?
InMobi is a global provider of enterprise platform for marketers. Our platforms help Marketers reach 1.56 billion unique users through mobile to help them engage, acquire, re-engage, re-market and retain valuable users. InMobi is also India’s first unicorn and one of the only profitable global tech-product companies to emerge out of India.
At 20+ offices across the globe, InMobi employs over 1000 personnel constituting 25 nationalities. Acclaimed for its culture, InMobi has consecutively featured on the Great Places to Work (GPTW) list, with a consistent hold in the Top 50 position for the past two years. Moreover, these accolades are not just restricted to India, InMobi has also secured a ranking on the GPTW’s 2017 China List, a notable feat for an Indian startup.
InMobi has also regularly featured on world disruptor lists – MIT Technology Review’s 2013 50 Disruptive Companies; Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies for 2016, 2018; CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list of 2018, here InMobi was selected amongst a pool of more than 980 forward-thinking and ambitiou private companies across the globe, we now share this space with the likes of SpaceX, Airbnb, Uber and so on.
What is the InMobi family like?
We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise to challenges, the innovative products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that.
What can we promise?
We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your engineering skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a reliable, scalable, secure, and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on innovative technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader.
Modern work environment, flexible schedule, and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. Internal opportunities to move roles and try out bridge assignments with different teams. Food for your soul – free meals all days of the week, gym, or Yoga class to flex those biceps, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.
What is the team like?
We are the CDR-AI team at InMobi, focused on building a next-generation Reporting, Analytics, and AI platform. Our mission is to transform raw data into actionable business insights for internal consumers while enabling seamless integration with multiple business and technology platforms.
As a platform team, we work closely with different lines of business across InMobi to understand their reporting, analytics, automation, and AI-driven decisioning needs. This gives the team a unique opportunity to solve high-impact business problems while working on large-scale data, analytics, and GenAI systems.
In addition to reporting and analytics, the team is expanding into AI engineering areas such as Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, and MCP-based integrations. We also work across cloud and AI platforms including GCP, Microsoft Azure, databases, GKE, REST APIs, and modern deployment frameworks. Microsoft positions Azure AI as an enterprise-grade platform for building AI apps and agents, which aligns with the team’s direction toward scalable AI-led platform capabilities.
Key technology areas:
AI/ML Engineering, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, MCP, Python, REST API Development, Spark, Java/J2EE, Airflow, Databricks, GKE, GCP, Microsoft Azure, Databases, Caching, Big Data Analytics.
What will you be doing?
- Act as an independent senior engineer, owning complex problem statements and delivering scalable, reliable solutions aligned with business goals.
- Stay current with emerging technologies such as Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Copilot Studio, while mentoring the team on adoption and best practices.
- Collaborate with product, business, data, and engineering stakeholders, and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Participate actively in architecture discussions, design reviews, sprint planning, and technical decision-making.
What do we expect from you?
- Design and build LLM-powered applications, chatbots, copilots, and multi-agent workflows
- Implement GenAI solutions using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, or similar.
- Build and maintain prompt templates, chains, agents, tools, and reusable AI workflows.
- Integrate vector databases for semantic search, contextual retrieval, RAG, and memory.
- Develop backend services, REST APIs, and integrations to run AI models in production.
- Ensure AI solutions are explainable, accurate, compliant, secure, and aligned with finance policies.
- Monitor and evaluate model and workflow performance on an ongoing basis.
- Optimize inference cost, latency, reliability, and overall system efficiency.
- Collaborate with Product, Data, Business, Sales, Finance, and Engineering teams to deliver end-to-end AI solutions.
- Stay updated on emerging GenAI, AI/ML, agentic AI, and automation technologies.
- Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and architecture reviews.
Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, or a related engineering discipline.
- 3–5 years of software development experience with hands-on expertise in Python, SQL, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and modern AI/ML frameworks.
- Experience designing and building LLM-powered applications, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector search, and fine-tuning pipelines.
- Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, n8n, or ReAct-style agents. LangGraph is designed for customizable single-agent, multi-agent, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Strong experience building REST APIs, microservices, and backend systems for production-grade applications.
- Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), including building or integrating MCP tools, servers, or capabilities. MCP enables servers to expose tools that language models can invoke to interact with external systems such as APIs, databases, and computation services.
- Good understanding of CI/CD, Docker, and containerized application development. Docker provides a standard way to package and run applications in lightweight containers with their dependencies.
- Working knowledge of data pipelines, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms such as Azure, GCP, or AWS.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills, with the ability to work effectively in agile engineering environments.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.
Nice to have skills
- Experience of online advertising domain
- Experience of working on massively large-scale data systems in production environments
- Experience of Big Data analytics domain
- Experience of building AI products that are powered by data and insights

About the Role:
We’re looking for a high-performing SDE-III with deep backend engineering expertise and strong foundations in data engineering that power the SSP Exchange team – a next-generation, AI-powered engineering platform working towards transforming ourselves into an Omni channel exchange .. You’ll be part of a cross-functional team responsible for designing and delivering mission-critical systems with high performance, reliability, and scale.As part of the engineering team, you will work at the intersection of AI, large-scale systems, and ad tech—developing intelligent experiences that simplify and automate the digital advertising lifecycle.
Who are we and What do we do?
InMobi is a global provider of enterprise platform for marketers. Our platforms help Marketers reach nearly 1.56 billion unique users through mobile to help them engage, acquire, re-engage, re-market and retain valuable users. InMobi is also India’s first unicorn and one of the only profitable global tech-product companies to emerge out of India.
At 20+ offices across the globe, InMobi employs over 1000 personnel constituting 25 nationalities. Acclaimed for its culture, InMobi has consecutively featured on the Great Places to Work (GPTW) list, with a consistent hold in the Top 50 position for the past two years. Moreover, these accolades are not just restricted to India, InMobi has also secured a ranking on the GPTW’s 2017 China List, a notable feat for an Indian startup.
InMobi has also regularly featured on world disruptor lists – MIT Technology Review’s 2013 50 Disruptive Companies; Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies for 2016, 2018; CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list of 2018, here InMobi was selected amongst a pool of more than 980 forward-thinking and ambitiou private companies across the globe, we now share this space with the likes of SpaceX, Airbnb, Uber and so on.
What’s the InMobi family like?
We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise up to challenges, the cutting edge products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and are on an accelerated path of being a leader in enterprise software for marketers. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion. We are here today because a few of us did just that.
What can we promise?
We offer you an opportunity to work on building enterprise platforms that require you to acquire, hone and demonstrate your engineering skills in designing and solving for complex problems, thereby creating software that creates value for our customers in a very reliable, scalable, secure and AI-first manner. At InMobi, you get to work on cutting-edge technologies, work closely with business teams and grow as an overall technology leader.
Modern work environment, flexible schedule and smart, creative, down-to-earth people. Internal opportunities to move roles and try out bridge assignments with different teams.  Food for your soul – free meals all days of the week, gym or Yoga class to flex those biceps, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.
What is the team like?
InMobi's Supply and Monetization Platform is one of the world's leading ad serving platforms serving 260bn ad requests a day and handling 2.5+ billion users. Our products help advertisers serve ads optimally, optimize relevance of ads to make the advertiser maximize his ROI, and monitor progress of different advertising campaigns. We handle 7M qps peak traffic for serving ads in milliseconds and manage 2 petabyte-scale data to match the pace of advertising
Key Responsibilities:
-
Design and develop large-scale backend services, APIs, and microservices for high-throughput data systems.
-
Build and maintain real-time and batch data pipelines using technologies like Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, etc.
-
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, data analysts and engineers to translate complex requirements into scalable solutions.
-
Optimize performance and reliability of distributed systems; ensure low-latency data ingestion and processing.
-
Champion code quality, performance, and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, containerization, observability, fault tolerance) and mentor juniors
-
Drive architectural decisions, lead technical discussions, and contribute to platform roadmap.
Qualifications:
-
5–8 years of backend engineering experience, preferably in large-scale, high-traffic environments.
-
Strong programming skills in Java, Scala, or Go; familiarity with Python for data use cases is a plus.
-
Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and concurrency.
-
Experience with modern data infrastructure (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow,Databricks , Presto, ClickHouse).
-
Exposure to cloud-native architecture (GCP/Azure) and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).
-
Strong problem-solving skills with a bias for action and ownership.
Nice to Have:
-
Experience working in AdTech, Martech, or E-Commerce domains.
-
Exposure to ML model lifecycle: training, serving, monitoring, and feedback loops.
-
Prior experience with AI-powered UX: conversational UI, suggestion engines, or personalization.
-
Agentic development (e.g., Cursor, LangChain, Windsurf) and building agents for business impact and dev productivity

Overview of the Role:
The Senior Account Manager is part of the Direct & Programmatic Demand team, embedded within a revenue pod alongside a dedicated Sales Manager, and working closely with agencies and advertisers across the Americas. Reporting to the VP, Ad Sales, this role will own new customer onboarding, delivering success for their campaigns and new upsell/cross-sell opportunities — while leading internal coordination with sales planning, operations, creative solutions, insights, measurement partnerships, supply partnerships, and tech teams.
Client-facing and regionally embedded, the Lead AM is a primary point of contact for the agency, owns the health of the account post-sale, and is directly responsible for identifying and closing upsell opportunities — that build on the success of the campaigns they run.
Location: This role is open to candidates based in Chicago, IL. Some travel may be required for client meetings and events as needed.
The Impact You'll Make:
- Onboard new advertiser customers in your Revenue pod onto InMobi and Glance ad systems and infrastructure
- Own the end-to-end delivery and KPI optimization of every deal sold by Sales Manager partners — coordinating research, creative, attribution, ad operations, and any other specialist teams required to execute what was sold.
- Act as the client's day-to-day point of contact post-sale, managing quarterly account retention and growth plans, revenue and margin management, and overall account health.
- Own upsell and cross-sell goals for your managed accounts — and track all upsell activities in Salesforce.
- Partner with your Sales Managers to co-own the account's long-term strategy, bringing proactive, data-driven recommendations and account intelligence that support the pod's overall revenue growth targets.
- Lead campaign analysis and reviews; provide consultative guidance to clients in weekly or bi-weekly check-ins and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).
- Manage the full solution lifecycle for campaigns individually and across partner teams — pre-sale media planning support, client onboarding, campaign delivery, in-flight optimization, and post-campaign reporting and deliverables.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, revenue strategy, technical account management (TAM), product marketing, ad operations, creative, insights, agency development, and demand partner teams to ensure successful execution and fast resolution of client issues.
- Work with Technical Account Management and Ops teams to troubleshoot campaign issues, and liaise directly with third-party partners such as DSPs, DMPs, and measurement vendors.
- Escalate at-risk accounts early — pacing issues, unresolved service problems, or stakeholder changes at the client
- Prioritize your week around what each account in your book needs — a renewal conversation, a QBR, resolving a client issue
- Surface marketplace feedback and client insights to inform InMobi's broader product and go-to-market strategy
How You're Measured:
This role is goaled on two connected outcomes:
- Pod revenue growth — shared accountability with your Sales Manager partners for the overall revenue performance of the accounts in your pod
- Individual revenue contribution — a dedicated, separately tracked upsell target generated from the deals you manage, logged and measured in Salesforce
The Experience We Need:
- 8+ years of overall client success or account management experience, including at least 4 years in digital and/or programmatic advertising.
- A proven track record of owning post-sale account health and driving measurable retention and growth within existing client accounts, including experience carrying or contributing to an upsell/renewal target.
- Strong ownership instincts and proactive communication — comfortable operating as one half of a tight, paired pod (AM + Seller) rather than managing an undifferentiated account list.
- Strong account management and client success experience, including managing complex agency and brand relationships and co-owning account strategy with a sales partner
- Hands-on experience with major DSPs and platforms such as The Trade Desk (TTD), DV360, and Amazon DSP is a strong plus
- Demonstrated success partnering with cross-functional teams (Sales, Ad Ops, Creative, Insights, Product) and building trusted relationships internally
- Proficiency with Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and analytics/BI tools
- Strong analytical skills — comfortable interpreting campaign data to identify performance trends, risks, and upsell opportunities, and translating them into clear client recommendations
- Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple clients, campaigns, and stakeholders simultaneously, and to reprioritize quickly as account needs shift
- Willingness and flexibility to work with global teams across several time zones
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
Why InMobi?
You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results.
At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…
- Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
- Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
- Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
- Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
- Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks
Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits
Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.
The base salary (fixed salary) for this role ranges from $140,500 to $175,000 USD (minimum to maximum base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.
*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the role in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.
In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of ESOPs (Employee Stock Option Plan). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.
A quick snapshot of our U.S. benefits:
- Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)
- High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)
- 401(k) company match
- Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays
- Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and compassionate work environment
- Flexible working hours to suit everyone
- Wellness stipend for a healthier you!
- Free lunch is provided in our offices daily
- Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals!
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Go for it!
InMobi is an equal opportunity employer
InMobi is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.
InMobi provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Finance BI team is part of FP&A and is responsible to upscale the organization towards data driven strategic decision making by adding the intelligence layer on top of this data - to unlock the huge potential that the right analytics could provide. This intelligence layer will be consumed towards unlocking productivity, realizing efficiencies, improving RoI for our various Products.
What You Will Do
Own finance data end to end
- Act as SME for finance data sources, definitions, and business logic across FP&A, Accounting, Revenue, and Business Units.
- Design and build Python and Spark (PySpark) pipelines that ingest, transform, and reconcile data from ERP, billing, ad platform, and operational systems into a governed analytics layer.
- Model data for finance use cases (P&L, unit economics, forecasting inputs, variance analysis, close reporting) with clear lineage and documented logic.
- Connect disconnected datasets across businesses and tools to create a single version of truth.
Analyze and find the signal
- Apply statistical methods to explain performance: regression, time-series forecasting, variance decomposition, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
- Explore large, messy datasets to find patterns, explain why numbers move, and turn those findings into recommendations leaders can act on.
- Validate models and metrics rigorously, including back-testing forecasts and quantifying uncertainty.
Automate reporting and decision support
- Replace manual reporting with automated, scheduled, and tested data solutions.
- Build interactive dashboards and metrics layers in Rill and Power BI that summarize performance and surface recommended actions, not just charts.
- Define metrics once in a governed semantic layer so every dashboard reports the same numbers.
Build AI agents and intelligent workflows
- Design and deploy automations, reporting and insight generation using agents and workflows for tasks such as commentary drafting, anomaly explanation, reconciliation checks, and ad hoc data Q&A.
- Identify where agents create real leverage and where simpler automation is the better answer.
Work independently and drive outcomes
- Scope requirements directly with stakeholders, make reasonable trade-offs, and deliver without step-by-step direction.
- Own the full lifecycle: technical design, build, testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and issue resolution.
- Write modular, reusable, version-controlled code that others can maintain.

- Python: data processing, automation, statistical analysis, and LLM integration
- Spark / PySpark: large-scale transformation (on Databricks or equivalent)
- SQL: modeling and analysis
- Rill: metrics views and operational dashboards
- Power BI: executive reporting
- Claude / LLM APIs: agent and workflow development
- Git: version control

Must-have
- 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or finance systems.
- Python: 2+ years, including writing tested, modular code for data pipelines and automation.
- Spark / PySpark: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production jobs on Databricks or a comparable platform.
- SQL: Strong, with experience modeling data for analytics and finance use cases.
- Rill or a comparable BI-as-code tool (Looker LookML, Cube, or similar): 1+ year of hands-on use, or a demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.
- Power BI: Working knowledge of data modeling and DAX (or equivalent).
- Statistics: Applied experience with regression, time-series forecasting, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
- ETL/ELT and lakehouse experience: Hands-on with tools such as Databricks, dbt, or Airflow, and familiarity with warehouse and lakehouse architecture.
- LLM APIs: Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude preferred), including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation.
- Finance fundamentals: Solid understanding of accounting, financial statements, and FP&A concepts. Able to build and check financial models.
- End-to-end delivery: A track record of translating a business problem into a sustainable data product and working independently as the go-to person for a domain.
- Communication: Able to document decisions, write clear specs, and explain results to non-technical leaders.
- Bachelor's or master’s in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field.
Good to have
- Experience with agent frameworks (MCP, LangGraph, or similar) and multi-step AI workflow orchestration.

- Experience in growing and maintaining complex, high-value managed accounts through a consultative approach.

- Proven experience in client-facing roles with a track record of delivering measurable business outcomes. Experience working with DSPs and/or MMPs is strongly preferred.
- Strategic mindset with a strong focus on revenue growth and retention; demonstrated success in driving account expansion and long-term client partnerships is highly valued.
- Proficiency with standard business tools, including Salesforce, Microsoft Office Suite, and reporting/visualization platforms such as Power BI and Tableau.
- Ability to manage multiple clients and campaigns simultaneously with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and disciplined time management.
