- Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks
Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits
Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.
The base salary (fixed) pay for this role ranges from $105,750 to $130,250 USD (min to max of base salary pay range). In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

The InMobi Group is the umbrella under which this ecosystem of businesses comes together. It spans:

- Enterprise platforms: InMobi Advertising, which provides media buyers and owners with the tools, data, and expertise to grow their business on mobile and beyond.
Each business serves its own audiences and has its own identity. At group level, InMobi is the common thread: the company, the technology, and the point of view behind them. This role helps shape how that group is presented and understood.
What is the role about?
The Senior Manager, Corporate Marketing is a group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. “Group level” means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. The incumbent is responsible for turning the group narrative into the flagship events and content through which the group is seen and heard.
The role is primarily B2B in focus. The incumbent’s purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders.
The incumbent will be the senior operator in the Corporate Marketing team: a leader who plans, builds, and delivers. The role works closely with the entire Corporate Marketing team and with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and across teams around the world, including leadership, engineering, product, design, talent, finance, and regional marketing functions. The incumbent owns the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the flagship events that carry the group narrative and the content and creative that bring it to life.

- Talent: experienced professionals, engineers, and early-career candidates considering InMobi.
- Investors and the financial community: stakeholders who assess InMobi’s strategy, leadership, and long-term potential.
- Technology community: engineers, data scientists, and product leaders who follow the work of leading technology teams.
- Industry thought leaders: analysts, journalists, and influential voices who shape perception of the category.

- Translate the group narrative into clear messaging, proof points, and content frameworks that every corporate programme draws on.
- Ensure that events and content speak in one consistent group voice, across businesses and regions.
- Partner with the wider Corporate Marketing team, including social media and community, so that what is said on stage, in print, and in the room is carried through consistently across channels.
Corporate Events and Flagship Platforms
- Own the strategy, planning, and delivery of large-scale corporate events, including flagship group events, leadership forums, industry summits, and employee-facing moments.
- Ensure each event brings the businesses together on one stage and gives audiences a single, coherent view of the group.
- Manage event agencies, vendors, and budgets, and coordinate delivery across time zones and markets.
- Extend the life of every event through content, social amplification, and follow-up with the audiences it was designed for.
Content and Creative
- Set the editorial direction for corporate content, including long-form articles, leadership perspectives, thought-leadership pieces, case studies, and video.
- Direct the writers, designers, and video producers who create corporate content, and maintain quality standards across everything published under the group name.
- Develop reusable content assets, such as the corporate story and event collateral, that regional and business teams can adopt.
Global Collaboration
- Work with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams and with regional, talent, finance, and engineering teams across the world to maintain a consistent group presence while reflecting local relevance.
- Act as the point of coordination for corporate marketing programmes across stakeholders, setting clear timelines, owners, and approvals.
Team and Partner Leadership
- Lead and develop a team of marketers, content creators, designers, and producers.
- Set priorities, workflows, and quality standards for the programmes the team delivers.
- Manage agency and external partnerships across events, content, creative, and production.
Measurement and Reporting
- Define KPIs across event reach and outcomes, content performance, and brand sentiment.
- Use analytics and audience feedback to refine programmes and report to senior leadership.
What is expected out of you?
- 10–12 years of experience in corporate marketing, communications, content, or brand, within technology, media, or high-growth environments, including at least 3 years leading people or large programmes.
- Strong B2B experience, preferably in technology, SaaS, adtech, or martech, with a record of building influence among professional and technical audiences.

- Excellent writing and editorial skills, with a clear, intelligent, and credible voice.
- Experience in video and visual storytelling, and in directing creative and content teams.
- Experience working with stakeholders across regions and time zones, including senior leadership.

Overview of the Role:
Every strong quarter starts with a plan people believe in. In this role, you'll build that plan for InMobi's North America Demand business.
Reporting to the Director – Global Revenue Operations, you'll provide revenue operations support across our programmatic and performance solutions sales teams, as well as our growth management and development teams. You'll own forecasting, territory and quota design, and named account list management for each of them, shaping both how we read the business and how every team goes after it.
Sales leadership will count on you as their analytical and operational partner. You'll give them an accurate, current read on where the business stands, and goals and territories their teams can act on with confidence. When the numbers move, you'll be the one who can explain why and recommend what comes next.
This role is a great fit for someone analytical and organized who is comfortable partnering directly with sales leadership, up to the C-suite. If you enjoy being the person leaders turn to for clarity, you'll find meaningful scope, visibility, and impact here.
Location: This role is based in our New York, NY, office and requires regular in-office presence. Occasional travel may be required for client meetings, industry events, etc.
The Impact You'll Make:
Forecast, Plan & Measure
- Own the recurring forecasting cadence for North America Agency & In-House sales, as well as Performance Solutions sales and account management across North America. This includes weekly and monthly forecasts, quarterly business plans, and the variance analysis needed to reconcile plan against actuals.
- Build and maintain forecast models across key revenue metrics for each business, surfacing risk and opportunity early enough for leadership to respond.
- Support the quarterly planning cycle end to end for each business: closing the prior quarter, finalizing the next quarter's forecast, and delivering targets ahead of the quarter start.
Goal Setting & Territory Support
- Lead territory, quota, and target setting for North America Agency Sales, Account Management, Client Development, Agency Development, and Performance Solutions teams, grounded in account potential, market maturity, and team capacity.
- Ensure quarterly quotas are set and delivered ahead of the quarter start, and that performance against quota is measured, transparent to every individual, and delivered ahead of payroll deadlines.
- Own the development and maintenance of named account lists for each team, using account potential, historical performance, and market data to determine coverage, ownership, and prioritization, and refresh assignments on a regular cadence.
- Partner with Finance and sales leadership to translate annual and quarterly plans into clear goals for each team and region.
Deep Knowledge of the Business
- Maintain a current, working understanding of the North America Agency, Brand, and Performance business, including key strategic priorities, revenue composition, and areas of risk and opportunity.
- Turn that knowledge into proactive recommendations when performance moves away from plan.
- Own core sales operations processes across these teams, including pipeline governance and reporting standards, applying the same definitions and data integrity checks used across the broader Revenue Operations organization.
Partnership with Sales Leadership
- Serve as the primary revenue operations partner to North America leadership.
- Apply one consistent operating standard across every team you support (one planning cadence, one goal-setting process, one source of truth) while staying attuned to the dynamics specific to each business.
- Represent these businesses in cross-functional forums with Finance, Product, and the broader Revenue Operations organization.
Individual Operating Efficiency
- Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to your own workflows to increase efficiency, freeing up more of your time for analysis and partnership rather than manual reporting.
The Experience We Need:
- 5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy, Business Operations, or a related field
- Experience leading end-to-end revenue planning and forecasting for a sales organization
- Hands-on experience with territory design and named account list development
- Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), BI tools (Excel, Tableau, Rill), and financial or forecast modeling
- Proven stakeholder management experience, including direct communication with senior sales leaders across more than one region
- Analytical rigor, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
- Background in the digital advertising or programmatic advertising industry
- An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus, but not required
Skills & Attributes That Will Set You Apart
- Business acumen: You can explain why a number moved based on a real understanding of the underlying business.
- Rigor: You produce forecasts and goals that are backed by data and delivered on schedule.
- Communication: You raise concerns and flag gaps to senior stakeholders directly, with data to support your position.
- Cross-regional depth: You build a working knowledge of the North America and EMEA markets, specific enough to defend the goals and territories set for each.
- Process discipline: You write SOPs and follow them consistently.
- Applied use of AI: You identify where automation and AI can increase your efficiency and apply them to your own workflow.
Why InMobi?
You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results.
At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…
- Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
- Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
- Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
- Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
- Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks
Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits
Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.
The base (fixed) salary for this role ranges from $169,000 to $234,000 USD (min to max of base salary). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*.
*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.
In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of Employee Stock Options (ESOPs). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.

- Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays

Über die Stelle:
InMobi sucht eine/n leidenschaftliche/n, ambitionierte/n und ergebnisorientierte/n Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, der/die die Neukundengewinnung für das App Performance Solutions-Team von InMobi in der DACH-Region und dem gesamten EMEA-Markt vorantreibt. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss hochwertiger Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit einigen der größten Marken in Nicht-Gaming-Verticals.
Sie werden Teil eines leistungsstarken Teams aus EMEA-Vertrieb, Client Growth und Media Buying unter App Performance Solutions, das Sie in Ihrem Wachstum und Erfolg im InMobi-Ökosystem aktiv unterstützt. Dies ist eine aufregende Möglichkeit, sichtbaren Einfluss in der EMEA-Region zu erzielen – für ein wachstumsstarkes Geschäftsfeld, das einen KI/ML-gestützten DSP, Owned-and-Operated Glance TV und Performance CTV umfasst.

Diese Stelle ist eine vollständig remote ausgeübte Position mit Sitz in Deutschland. Fließende Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind erforderlich. Gelegentliche Reisetätigkeit für Kundenmeetings, Branchenveranstaltungen und persönliche Team-Meetings wird erwartet.

Als Senior Sales Manager, EMEA sind Sie verantwortlich für den Aufbau und die Entwicklung eines Portfolios aus Direktmarken und Performance-Agenturen in der DACH-Region durch den Verkauf effektiver App Performance Solutions. Darüber hinaus gestalten Sie aktiv die Vertriebsstrategie, den Go-to-Market-Ansatz und den Ausführungsplan von InMobi für Ihre Schlüsselregion innerhalb von EMEA mit.
- Identifikation, Akquise, Beratung und Entwicklung neuer Beziehungen zu strategisch relevanten Marken, Agenturen und Partnern zur Sicherung des langfristigen Wachstums der App Performance Solutions von InMobi
- Nutzung Ihrer Marktkenntnis und der einzigartigen Wettbewerbsvorteile von InMobi zur Entwicklung neuer und nachhaltiger Geschäftsbeziehungen mit Werbetreibenden – einschließlich der Navigation in programmatischen und Walled-Garden-Ökosystemen
- Pflege von Beziehungen zu Ökosystem-Influencern, MMPs, Agenturen und Partnern, um InMobi bei deren Kunden stets präsent zu halten
- Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Lifecycle – von der Outbound-Prospektion und Inbound-Lead-Qualifizierung über die Angebotserstellung, Nurturing und Aktivierung bis hin zur strategischen Wachstumsberatung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams aus Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships und Product für ein reibungsloses Onboarding und die Übergabe an das Growth-Team
- Repräsentation von InMobi App Performance Solutions bei wichtigen Branchenveranstaltungen, Konferenzen und Networking-Events in der gesamten EMEA-Region
- Diszipliniertes Pipeline-Management unter Nutzung von CRM-Tools für präzise Prognosen und Performance-Tracking
- Kontinuierliches Übertreffen der vierteljährlichen Umsatzziele durch strategische Neukundengewinnung und starkes Beziehungsmanagement
Ihr Profil:
- Branchenerfahrung. Sie verfügen über 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Hunting und Selling an App-Unternehmen und Performance-Agenturen. Sie kennen deren Herausforderungen und sind bekannt dafür, Umsatz aufzubauen – nicht nur Bestandsgeschäfte zu verwalten, sondern neue zu schaffen.
- Advertising Technology Expertise. Sie haben mindestens 6+ Jahre Erfahrung im Ad Tech und kennen das EMEA-Ökosystem sehr gut. Erfahrung bei einem führenden Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP oder einem anderen Online-Werbunternehmen ist erforderlich.
- Vertrauenswürdiger Berater. Sie verfügen über authentische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, schnell konsultative, glaubwürdige und langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen. In einem Markt voller Anbieter denken Ihre Kunden zuerst an Sie – nicht weil Sie verkauft haben, sondern weil Sie Probleme gelöst haben.
- Hochenergetische/r, leidenschaftliche/r Self-Starter. Sie sind von Natur aus hochmotiviert, Ehrgeiz liegt in Ihrer DNA, und Sie fühlen sich in einem schnelllebigen, risikofreudigen und oft mehrdeutigen Umfeld sehr wohl.
- Analytische Stärke und überzeugendes Storytelling. Sie verfügen über starke analytische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, versteckte Chancen zu erkennen und daraus überzeugende Narrative zu entwickeln, die Kunden zum Handeln bewegen.
- Proaktive/r Problemlöser/in. Sie haben nachgewiesene Fähigkeiten, Kundenschmerzpunkte und technische Herausforderungen zu lösen und durch funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit Lösungen zu entwickeln.
- Wissbegierig und lernbereit. Sie sind von Natur aus neugierig, handeln proaktiv und suchen aktiv nach Wegen, Ihre Kollegen zu unterstützen. Die Ad-Tech-Landschaft verändert sich ständig – Signal-Verlust, KI-Disruption, verändertes Käuferverhalten – und Sie engagieren sich aktiv statt abzuwarten.
- Ausbildung. Ein Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in einem relevanten Fachbereich ist erforderlich, oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung. Ein MBA oder ein weiterführender Masterabschluss ist von Vorteil.
- Sprachen. Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind zwingend erforderlich.
Bei InMobi sind Sie umgeben von Menschen, die:
- Groß denken und schnell handeln — wir sind unternehmerisch, gedeihen in Mehrdeutigkeit und lösen gerne wirkungsvolle Probleme
- Leidenschaftlich sind und enormen Stolz auf ihre Arbeit legen — wir kümmern uns tief um die Wirkung, die wir erzielen
- Ihre Ergebnisse verantworten — wir übernehmen Verantwortung, treffen mutige Entscheidungen und handeln mit Überzeugung
- Freiheit mit Verantwortung verbinden — wir schätzen Autonomie und verstehen, dass Vertrauen mit Verantwortung einhergeht
- An lebenslanges Lernen glauben — wir begrüßen Feedback, fordern uns selbst heraus und scheuen keine klugen Risiken
Vergütung & Benefits
Unsere Vergütungsphilosophie ermöglicht es uns, wettbewerbsfähige Gehälter anzubieten, die Hochleistung fördern und gleichzeitig Geschäftsanforderungen sowie Lohngleichheit berücksichtigen. Das Grundgehalt oder die Festvergütung für diese Stelle liegt zwischen €132.500 und €167.250 (Minimum bis Maximum des Grundgehalts). Zusätzlich zum Grundgehalt können Sie variable Vergütung in Form eines jährlichen oder vierteljährlichen Leistungsbonus oder Sales Incentive erhalten, gemäß InMobi-Richtlinie.

title: Senior Sales Manager - Johannesburg, South Africa
description:
InMobi (Corporate)
InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.
InMobi Advertising
InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.
Glance
Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.
Role Overview
Microsoft and InMobi have entered into a strategic partnership. As per this, InMobi Advertising will be the exclusive partner for Microsoft Advertising's search & display inventory. Microsoft Search Advertising empowers the largest advertisers around the world to reach their maximum potential through paid search engine marketing on the Microsoft Bing Ads platform. InMobi will be responsible for complete business management/transaction across Microsoft Advertising.
As a Regional Lead in South Africa you are expected to drive new client acquisition and grow incremental revenue against a targeted list of high potential agencies and advertisers through continuous engagement. You are expected to continually build and maintain a pipeline of clients and agencies to be onboarded to the Microsoft Advertising platform. Collaborate with internal Account Managers and Strategy teams to develop quality customer plans targeted at revenue growth and customer satisfaction. Cultivating strategic client relationships, revenue generation and delivering customized search solutions will be key to your core function. Your success will be measured by specific key performance indicators focused on driving new customer acquisition, product adoption, emphasizing customer experience and optimizing opportunities.
What is expected out of you?
In the first quarter:
- Understand the Microsoft Advertising Ecosystem in South Africa and collaborate with internal stakeholders.
- Leverage your current relationships in the advertising ecosystem to drive revenue conversations as well as open up new relationships in the industry
- You will be expected to build a healthy predictable pipeline of clients to initiate and successfully close partnership and onboarding discussions.
- Consistently create high value revenue-generating opportunities that will work towards delivering quota expectations.
- Lead regular, impactful engagements with key clients.
- Coordinate with the required teams to help achieve targets.
Second Quarter Onwards:
- Master and grow the activities initiated in the first quarter
- Grow Bing’s share of wallet by continuing to onboard new clients and agencies
- Strengthen relationships with key client and agency stakeholders like (budget decision makers, media planners and senior leadership)
- Collaborate with internal account managers and client poc's to ensure opportunities are leveraged effectively
- Continually strengthen your Search Industry expertise, take personal accountability for your career and personal development;
- Complete required and recommended trainings and apply what you learn to further your growth in role and career progression
Role requirement & expectation:
- 12 years of work experience with 5+ years of online media sales/digital advertising experience
- Strong network of clientele in the South African marketplace, specifically Johannesburg and an understanding of the key digital players (Brands, agencies etc.)
- Experience and ability to build a client base from scratch.
- Experience in lead generation, networking, and ad-agency relationship management.
- Experienced Digital media solution seller and talented in storytelling and delivering engaging presentations across all levels of leadership
- Ability to handle and manage key/strategic client relationships and revenue
- Ensure a strong metrics focused approach is applied in business planning and execution
- Proven ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions
- Proven track record of exceptional performance, high productivity, communications skills, and meeting deadlines. Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals or targets
- Passion for technology as an enabler for company growth
- Effectively navigate through ambiguity and complexities related to client management
- Practice freedom with responsibility, entrepreneurial mindset and thought leadership.
- Possess excellent communication skills providing transparency and enabling information radiators
- Travel to meet and strengthen partnerships with new and existing clients.
Preferred:
- Search Engine Marketing Experience
- Understanding of the Digital Ecosystem
- Ad Sales Experience
Location:
Johannesburg

Overview of the Role:
InMobi is seeking a driven, relationship-first Senior Sales Manager to quarterback a defined book of business across the US West region (covers the West Coast, Pacific Northwest, Mountain, and Texas) focused on Independent Agencies and Advertiser In-house teams. Embedded within a revenue pod alongside a dedicated Account Manager, and reporting to the VP, Ad Sales - North America, you will be the face of InMobi to every agency in your book — building trust, opening doors, and closing revenue across both Programmatic Marketplace (PMP) deals and Direct IOs.
This is a hunting and farming role in equal measure: you'll be expected to arrive with established relationships across the agencies and direct advertisers that you're hired to cover, and to put those relationships to work immediately — growing existing accounts while consistently generating net-new business from new customers. You will be responsible for identifying new hunting opportunities from net new customers in your territory, thus constantly expanding your target account list.
Together with your paired Account Manager, you'll co-own your pod's long-term account strategy, one relationship, one pipeline, one shared goal of sustained growth.
Location: We welcome applicants based in either San Mateo, CA (SF/Bay Area) or Los Angeles, CA for this role
The Impact You'll Make:
- Quarterback your book of business end-to-end — owning the agency and advertiser in-house relationship, the pipeline, and the revenue outcome across every account in your patch in the West region
- Serve as the face of InMobi to independent agencies and advertiser in-house teams in the West region: build genuine relationships through consistent presence, entertainment, and strategic engagement that goes beyond the transaction
- Maintain accurate, current industry intelligence to identify book expansion opportunities
- Drive net-new business as a core focus, primarily by hunting new agencies as well as in-house clients
- Build, advise, and grow relationships with media account teams at agencies to ensure long-term success and adoption of InMobi's suite of products (including Glance CTV, Glance mobile, InMobi Exchange solutions). Maximize face time with clients, which will involve travel to the agency territory offices.
- Bring a strategic point of view to every account: build territory and account plans that identify where InMobi can win, and pursue them proactively rather than reactively
- Lead responses to advertiser/agency RFPs, ensuring clear, consistent, and comprehensive representation of InMobi's solutions and capabilities to develop custom, differentiated proposals that win competitive RFPs
- Partner closely with your Account Manager to co-own long-term account strategy — bringing the relationship and pipeline view, while trusting your AM's data-driven recommendations on where existing accounts have room to grow
- Represent InMobi at industry events, upfronts, and client entertainment, strengthening InMobi's presence and reputation across the agency community
- Maintain accurate, disciplined forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce, reflecting realistic net-new and renewal mix against the SIP plan, and keeping account intelligence (org changes, competitive risk, budget cycles) current for the POD
How You're Measured:
This role is goaled on two connected outcomes, per the SIP planning framework:
- Pod revenue growth — shared accountability with your Account Manager for the overall retention, renewal, and revenue performance of the accounts in your book, tracked through year-over-year (YoY) growth across both deal-based revenue and Managed Service IOs
- Net-new business contribution — Ability to generate net new business from new agencies and in-house teams
The Experience We Need:
- 8+ years of advertising sales experience, with a track record of selling into independent agencies and in-house teams across programmatic and/or managed service advertising.
- Established, verifiable relationships with independent agencies and/or client in-house teams in the US West region, validated through the interview process.
- A demonstrated history of exceeding revenue targets, with meaningful contributions from net-new business (new logos or new campaigns), not renewals alone.
- Strong command of both PMP/programmatic deal structures and Managed Service IO selling, with the versatility to move fluidly between the two.
- Natural relationship-building instincts: someone who genuinely enjoys client entertainment, agency events, and being a visible, trusted presence in the market.
- A consultative, strategic sales style — comfortable building account plans, developing custom solutions with internal partners, and leading complex RFP processes.
- Strong collaboration skills, with experience partnering closely with Account Management, Client Solutions, Sales Planning, Marketing, and Product teams.
- Comfort with disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in Salesforce.
- A bias for action in fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environments, with an entrepreneurial mindset.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Why InMobi?
You'll be part of a global team shaping the future of the open internet's advertising ecosystem — with visible impact, a supportive and ambitious peer group, and continuous investment in your growth. InMobi offers competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a culture built on ownership, curiosity, and results.
At InMobi, you’ll be surrounded by people who…
- Think big and act fast: We’re entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
- Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
- Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
- Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
- Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren’t afraid to take smart risks
Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits
Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.
The base salary (fixed) pay range for this role would range from $120,750 to $148,000 USD (min to max of base salary pay). This salary range is applicable to our offices located in California and New York*. In addition, an InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.
*Our ranges may vary based on the final location or region of the roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country.
In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity in the form of Employee Stock Options (ESOPs). We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stock to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company’s best interests. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.
A quick snapshot of our U.S. benefits:
- Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)
- High-quality medical, dental, and vision insurance (including company-matched HSA)
- 401(k) company match
- Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays
- Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and a compassionate work environment
- Flexible working hours to suit everyone
- Wellness stipend for a healthier you!
- Free lunch provided in our offices daily
- Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals!
- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Go for it!
InMobi is an equal opportunity employer
InMobi is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.

Overview of the Role:
Adtech and agentic commerce are dense, fast, and technical by nature. The job is to make them intriguing and to do it with taste.
InMobi Group is redefining how brands advertise and how people discover and shop, across a portfolio spanning InMobi Advertising and Glance. This role is the editorial engine of our enterprise marketing organization. As the Lead, Enterprise Content & Social, you'll shape how the Group tells its story, turning intricate products into content people actually want to read. Your work spans three interconnected lanes: content and social, content operations, and measurement. You'll own editorial planning and organic social, build the systems that make great content easier to create and distribute, and track what's working so the team keeps getting sharper.
At its core, this is a writing and editorial role. It's a high-ownership individual contributor position with broad surface area, ideal for someone who is data-informed but taste-led, looking for scope that runs ahead of the title and room to grow inside a category-defining company.
You'll work with Product Marketing, Brand, Communications, Creative, Regional Marketing, Events, and Executive Leadership to run campaigns, support executive thought leadership, and translate the complexity of adtech and agentic commerce into clear, compelling stories. We value curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and a good sense of humor.
Location: This role is based in New York, New York, with periodic travel of roughly 15 to 25% for conferences, customer events, executive engagements, and team offsites, plus content support around major launches and live events across global time zones. This is a global team, so Eastern Time hours are common even when working from the West Coast.
The Impact You'll Make:
Content & Social
- Own the integrated editorial calendar across the enterprise portfolio, connecting campaign themes to platform-native publishing
- Run content from planning through publishing and reporting

The ideal candidate will manage advertiser relationships, drive campaign performance, identify opportunities for account growth, and ensure a high standard of client service.
This role requires a combination of platform expertise, analytical thinking, client relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple accounts, solving problems independently, and translating client objectives into effective advertising strategies.
Key Responsibilities
- Account Management & Client Relationships
- Own day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of advertisers, ensuring strong engagement, timely communication, and high client satisfaction.
- Understand client business objectives, marketing priorities, target audiences, and performance expectations.
- Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing strategic recommendations to improve campaign outcomes and grow advertising investments.

- Monitor campaign performance against KPIs such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPM, and other relevant business metrics.

- Support advertisers in troubleshooting campaign delivery, tracking, attribution, and performance-related challenges.

- Drive account growth by identifying opportunities to increase advertiser investment and improve campaign effectiveness.
- Develop account plans aligned with client objectives, revenue targets, and business priorities.
- Maintain visibility into account-level performance, revenue forecasts, growth opportunities, and potential risks.
- Work closely with sales teams to support client acquisition, onboarding, account expansion, and retention.
- Contribute to business reviews, quarterly planning, and revenue-growth initiatives.

Position Summary:
We are looking for a Staff Applied Science Manager to lead and grow a team of talented data scientists who have direct impact on our company metrics. The performance of our models and experiments is seen astonishingly quickly – the learning loop is not measured in weeks or days, but hours and minutes. We live in what might be the fastest model-learning playgrounds in the world, with an infrastructure that enables model deployment at both scale and speed.
In this role, you will combine deep technical credibility with strong people leadership. You will build and mentor a high-performing team of data scientists, set technical direction, and drive disciplined program execution across multiple concurrent workstreams. You will sit alongside engineering colleagues who enable our models to deploy, and with a growing variable set of hundreds of potential features, you will lead a highly fertile environment for building, experimenting, refining and achieving real, fast impact.
Who Are You?
- You bring deep expertise and experience in Ad Tech, AI/ML, and Data Science at scale, along with a track record of leading and developing data science talent. Familiarity with big data processing and cloud computing is critical to succeed in this environment.
- In addition to a strong mathematical foundation (Statistics, Probability Theory, Algorithms, Foundations of Machine Learning), you are fluent in data science languages and tools such as Python or Apache Spark, and can guide your team in designing scalable solutions, building proofs-of-concept, and evaluating them offline and online.
- You have a demonstrated ability to manage people – hiring, coaching, and growing data scientists at different stages of their careers – as well as manage programs: planning roadmaps, sequencing priorities, managing dependencies, and ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery across a portfolio of initiatives.
- You are passionate about investigating and learning from data, and about creating an environment where your team is driven to ask interesting and provocative questions and put real models into production that drive real business value.
- You are comfortable balancing hands-on technical involvement with the responsibilities of people management and cross-functional program leadership.
- We are open to diverse academic backgrounds. Our team includes engineers, mathematicians, computer scientists, physicists, economists and social scientists – a rock-star applied science leader can come from any academic field.
What Will You Do?
- Lead and grow a team of data scientists working on one or more data science efforts for InMobi DSP, a gold mine that is being explored for riches. This spans project ideation and conceptualization, solution design, measurement and iteration, coaching, deployment, and post-deployment management.
- Own program execution across your team's portfolio: define roadmaps, sequence priorities, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure initiatives are delivered on time and with high quality.
- Manage, mentor, and develop data scientists – setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, supporting career growth, and building a strong bench of technical talent.
- Remain hands-on where it matters: guide the design, development, and testing of product experiments, and stay close enough to the data and models to unblock your team and make sound technical calls.
- Drive stakeholder management as the interface with internal stakeholders such as Product, Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, and Business teams, translating business needs into technical roadmaps and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly.
- Champion thought leadership for the team. We encourage and support team members to write blogs, commentary, and case studies published on the InMobi blog, and to speak at industry conferences representing InMobi's work.
- Help your team connect model design to business context and end-user needs, and ensure model impact is consistently tied to measurable business outcomes.
- Foster a multi-functional collaboration model, working closely with engineering, product, business, campaign management, and creative development teams, and helping your team draw on the strengths of this diverse group.
- Create the space for your team to experiment with multiple algorithms and learn from what works and what doesn't – reviewing performance, asking why, and adapting techniques to fit the problem at hand, in an environment built for speed.
- Encourage creativity in model design across your team. Model design is not one-size-fits-all; you will guide your team in building layered models and feedback mechanisms for tougher problems in a dynamic environment.
- Represent your team's contributions in the company's broader efforts to innovate and demonstrate thought leadership through products, research papers, and conferences.
Required Skills:
- Master's in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research or Economics, Analytics, or Data Science. Or a Bachelor's from a reputed college with additional relevant experience.
- 10-14 years of work experience in a quantitative field, including model building and validation experience, with at least 2-3 years in a people management or team leadership capacity (direct reports, mentoring, or technical team leadership).
- Proven experience managing programs or portfolios of data science initiatives – setting roadmaps, prioritizing across competing demands, tracking milestones, and driving delivery in a fast-paced environment.
- Ad tech related industry experience is a strong plus. You would have applied algorithms and techniques from Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Statistics or other domains to solve real-world problems and understand the practical issues of using these algorithms on large datasets.
- Comfortable with software programming and statistical platforms such as R, Python etc., including visualization tools.
- Comfortable with the big data ecosystem and Apache Spark. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud/Vertex AI is a bonus.
- Strong track record of hiring, coaching, and retaining data science talent, and of fostering a culture of curiosity, rigor, and accountability within a team.
- Familiarity with the challenges of the identity-less world, particularly for iOS and Android.
- Excellent technical and business communication skills, with the ability to present technical ideas simply to business counterparts and to represent your team's work to senior stakeholders.

This is a high-impact engineering team operating at the intersection of CRM, AI-driven agents, integrations, and modern enterprise platforms.

- Build features enabling seamless integration between Salesforce structured/unstructured data and downstream AI agents for faster insights and decision-making.
- Deploy and monitor Salesforce-integrated products with an emphasis on agent observability, telemetry, and auditability.
- Develop best-in-class data health monitoring and context enrichment pipelines to ensure CRM data used by agents is reliable, governed, and audit-ready.
Agentic AI & intelligent automation
- Lead technical solutioning for full-lifecycle projects focused on how Salesforce will power autonomous workflows, co-pilots, and multi-agent systems - contributing to a "data-first, agent-aware" architecture strategy.
- Partner with product management and business stakeholders to prioritize CRM data products that drive autonomous decision-making, context-rich recommendations, and discoverable data services for next-gen AI agents and LLM-based systems.

- Architect and scale distributed systems that interact with Salesforce for real-time data synchronization, leveraging Kafka, Spark, or similar streaming technologies.
- Write clean, testable, and high-performance backend middleware in Java that bridges CRM and cloud services at scale.
Engineering excellence

- 2–3 years of hands-on experience with Agentforce, Data Cloud, and cloud platforms (GCP or Azure) and their connectivity to Salesforce.
- Deep expertise in Salesforce architecture: Apex, LWC, Salesforce Shield, CRM data modelling, and high-volume data processing patterns.
- Proven experience with advanced Salesforce integrations including Platform Events, CDC, and complex REST/SOAP API integrations.
- Experience writing optimized SOQL/SOSL and managing large datasets within Salesforce multi-tenant environments.
- Experience writing clean, testable backend code in Java or Python for middleware services (Apache Camel, MuleSoft) bridging CRM and external cloud services.
- Mastery of Salesforce DX, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Copado), and AI automated testing and deployment frameworks.

Building a new company in the recession of 2007 was no ordinary task. Yet with passion and foresight, we charted our course, helping to transform the way consumers engage with their phones. Over the last 17 years, InMobi has built a global Advertising Platform that powers our customers’ growth by helping them engage their audiences and drive real connections.
InMobi has also built a second unicorn, Glance, which is advancing digital consumption and creating a new wave of disruption. Present on 400M devices across India, SEA, Japan and the US – Glance is one of the largest content platforms globally with~200M daily active users.

We help advertisers reach and engage with their target audience globally. We do this through a deep understanding of people, which is enabled through our algorithms that respect privacy. Today, some of the world's largest brands, agencies, developers and publishers are creating great value by using our platforms to deliver compelling proposition to their target consumers.
Currently, we provide over 1.4 billion mobile users with relevant advertisements that enable meaningful decisions. We display 10 billion advertisements on a daily basis!

We are an infectious bunch. Be it the way we rise up to challenges, the cutting edge products we create, the dreams we chase or the fun we have at work. We are sure that if you meet us, you will be infected too. Today, we are proud to be the leaders in Mobile advertising and we are sure to go even higher from here. Who are we and What do we do?
InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies.
What’s the InMobi family like?
Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results-focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.
What do we promise?
We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.
What will you be doing?
We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Manager to build and lead the ML function for Accelerate. You will own the entire ML stack - from defining the roadmap to hiring the team to shipping models into production. This is not a role where you inherit an existing ML system; you will architect and build the foundational ML capabilities that become the platform's core competitive moat: cross-channel intelligence that autonomously optimizes marketing spend.
You will report to the engineering leadership and work closely with product, data engineering, and the existing platform engineering team.
What You'll Build
Cross-Channel Budget Allocation Engine Build optimization models that allocate a brand's total marketing budget across channels to maximize aggregate ROAS. Account for channel-specific dynamics: auction mechanics, audience overlap, frequency caps, diminishing returns curves. Move from static allocation to continuous rebalancing based on real-time performance signals.
Bid Optimization & Pacing Develop bid strategy models that work across platforms with different auction types. Build spend pacing algorithms that distribute budget optimally across time (dayparting, day-of-week, seasonality). Model the response curves (spend vs. conversions) per channel and campaign type.
Multi-Touch Attribution Build cross-channel attribution models that go beyond last-click to understand the true incremental value of each channel and touchpoint. Design incrementality testing frameworks to validate attribution models and feed insights back into budget allocation and bid optimization.
Performance Forecasting Predict campaign performance (impressions, clicks, conversions, ROAS) before and during campaign execution. Build anomaly detection to flag underperforming campaigns or unusual spend patterns in real-time.
Audience Intelligence Build audience segmentation and lookalike modeling that works across channel boundaries. Identify high-value audience segments and optimize targeting recommendations based on historical cross-channel conversion data.
Creative Performance Prediction Predict creative asset performance before launch, identify creative fatigue signals, and connect creative attributes (copy, visuals, CTA type) to performance outcomes.
What We're Looking For
- 8+ years in ML/Data Science, with at least 1 year in a tech lead or management role building and shipping ML systems in production
- Strong ML breadth with depth in at least one of: optimization algorithms, recommender systems, time-series forecasting, causal inference, reinforcement learning, or auction/marketplace ML
- Hands-on technical leader: You can architect ML systems, review model code, and mentor engineers - not just manage roadmaps
- Production ML experience: You've taken models from research to production, dealt with data quality issues, and understand the gap between offline metrics and business impact
- Ads/MarTech domain experience is a strong plus: bid optimization, budget allocation, attribution, audience targeting, or media mix modeling at an ad platform, DSP, or marketing platform
Why This Role
- Greenfield ML with real data: The platform already has production data flowing from major ad platforms. You're not waiting for data - you're building the intelligence layer on top of a live system
- Clear business impact: Every model you build has a direct line to ROAS improvement for brands. The feedback loop between model and revenue is short
- The problem is genuinely hard: Cross-channel marketing optimization is a multi-objective, partially-observable, adversarial optimization problem. The ad platforms themselves are black boxes. Building intelligence across them is an unsolved problem at the industry level
- Full ownership: You define the ML strategy, hire the team, choose the tools, and ship the models. No inherited tech debt in the ML layer
- Scale potential: InMobi is one of the largest independent ad-tech companies globally. Accelerate is a strategic bet with executive sponsorship
